ex.s: You do not have to be a fan to recognise the skill of professional players - how they use their bodies to pass, score and defend can be amazing to see - or to fell the excitement of a game ending with a surprising twist.

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.

ex.s: My own conviction on this score dates from the day I saw a wolf die.
ex.t: 我本人对这点的信念，始于我亲眼看见一只狼死去的那天。

ex.t: 他的工作是坐在钢琴家旁边翻乐谱，这样音乐家就不必自己翻谱而打断音乐的流畅性。
